title: Qurves
tagline: Light cycles in superposition: split into mirrored copies, and lose only when every copy crashes.
description: Steer your light cycle and make the others crash into a trail. Drive over an H gate and your bike splits into mirrored copies; you only lose the round when every copy has crashed. Drive through a rival's ghost trail to measure it, X jumps you across the arena with a shield, and Z shields you. For 2 or 4 players, first to 3 rounds.

keyboard.p1: W A S D (or G C V B) to steer, Space to pause
keyboard.p2: Arrows (or I J K L) to steer, Enter to pause

how_to_play: Steer with the stick or the X Y B A buttons. Don't crash into a trail.
H splits you into mirrored copies: you only lose when every copy crashes.
Drive through a ghost trail to measure it. X jumps across and shields you, Z shields you.
With 4 players, each pad's stick is one player and its buttons another.
Start (Space or Enter) pauses the game.
